requirements.title: Atmosphere: quiet, dense when needed, responsive under pressure; status motion communicates work rather than decorating it. Harness branding replaces identity only; Grok's observable spatial and temporal grammar is the target.

Primary journeys: start and draft; submit/queue/interject/cancel/recover; inspect and navigate long transcript; operate dashboard sessions; preview media; change theme; respond to permissions/questions entirely by keyboard or mouse.

Personas: keyboard-first expert; mouse/trackpad user; user on ANSI16/legacy-key/no-graphics terminal through tmux/SSH; CJK/emoji user; motion-sensitive user with animations disabled. A failure for any applicable persona blocks its task.

Canonical read-only Grok source checkout: `/home/urbanbreach/Projects/agent-harness/inspirations/grok-build`. Every relative `inspirations/grok-build/...` reference in this plan resolves to that canonical checkout, not to a copy inside the task worktree. Source guards must validate its pinned revision and immutability before and after every read/build/run.

Deliver a Harness-native TUI whose observable layout, interaction results, state choreography, keyboard/mouse behavior, motion cadence, terminal integration, and failure recovery match the canonical Grok Build binary built from source revision `eb267feff13129e568df38fb6fdf0ceb65f735d6`.

Cover six independently verifiable systems: reference/evidence lab; shell/design primitives; structured composer and attachment transport; transcript/navigation/mouse/motion; first-class dashboard; media/themes/title/notifications/tips.

Preserve Harness product identity and authority. The scenario schema permits exactly two substitution categories: `identity_text` and `truthful_dynamic_text` (auth/model/workspace/session/provider values). Every span records field kind, canonical placeholder, explicit reference and candidate values, separate reference and candidate provenance, exact cell rectangle, style, and wrap contract. Both captured placements must match before masking. Regex, row, component, and region masks are forbidden; all other cells and pixels compare exactly.

Treat visible attachments as functional end-to-end data: composer atom -> `UiIntent` -> coordinator event/projection -> replay/compaction -> provider request/capability serialization. Every attachment must be replayable, redacted, bounded, cancellable, and cleaned up.

Implement all three transcript surfaces independently: in-place screen mode, selected-block full-screen viewer with raw/search/copy, and external pager suspend/restore. Each restores selection, fold, focus, and follow state exactly.
Exercise keyboard-first, mouse/trackpad-first, reduced-capability terminal, CJK/emoji/wide-text, and reduced-motion users throughout implementation rather than as final polish.

Every implementation todo owns an observable vertical-slice scenario and runs both binaries. Internal prerequisites must be merged into the first consuming slice; there are no evidence-free foundation tasks.

Preserve the user-owned edits in `crates/harness-tui/src/app/model_switcher.rs` and `crates/harness-tui/tests/model_switcher/cycle_test.rs`; execution occurs in a task-owned worktree and integrates without reverting them.
Treat only current Harness/Grok source code, tests, Cargo/package manifests, and fresh execution of the two current binaries as research inputs.

Do not copy, translate, mechanically transform, vendor, link, or runtime-depend on Grok source, tests, fixtures, scenarios, themes, art, text, internal crates, or identifiers. Grok source describes observable behavior; all Harness implementation and tests are independently authored.
Do not edit anything below `inspirations/grok-build`; build it only with an isolated `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` and prove byte-identical source status before and after every reference run.

Do not downgrade Ratatui 0.30.1 or Crossterm 0.29. New dependencies require an owner test, license/supply-chain/offline review, and a capability that cannot be implemented correctly with the current stack.

Do not use screenshots, fixed-width pre-rendered text, hardcoded availability, stale artifacts, self-comparison, broad masks, skipped scenarios, forced-kill-only success, or reviewer self-certification as parity evidence.

Do not treat successful dual capture as comparison success. A `PASS` is legal only when the production runner invokes semantic-cell, pixel, motion, and timing comparators and the receipt contains their explicit zero-difference verdicts.

Do not complete a parity module from isolated unit tests or `pub mod` registration. Completion requires a source-traceable path from real `AppState` and input/event dispatch through `runtime` to `ui::render_app`, plus an installed-binary scenario that visibly exercises the module.
Do not waive required test lanes as pre-existing. An untouched-revision reproduction may identify provenance, but any failure named as release-blocking keeps Todo 50 and all final gates rejected.
Do not move event append, permission resolution, provider/tool execution, replay mutation, redaction, or lifecycle authority into the TUI. Replay remains side-effect free and event-derived.
Do not broaden into unrelated Grok CLI, provider, auth, update, extension, or server parity except for the minimum Harness-owned path required by a scoped visible TUI action.

Test decision: evidence-first TDD with Rust unit/integration tests via `cargo nextest`, deterministic fake clocks, real PTYs, and xterm.js/Chromium captures. Each slice starts with a fresh Grok observation and an independently authored failing Harness owner test.

Evidence root: every recovery run creates one immutable `.omo/evidence/recovery-<candidate-full-sha>-<attempt-id>/` root. Tasks 53-59, 49-52, and F1-F4 all resolve beneath that root. Revoked directories remain untouched and may not be comparison or approval inputs. Each task directory contains `reference/`, `candidate/`, `diff/`, `commands.log`, `receipt.json`, `cleanup.json`, and `secret-scan.json`.

Every `receipt.json` records source revisions and clean status, binary paths/version/SHA-256, Cargo.lock/toolchain hashes, OS/TERM/multiplexer/locale/font/DPR/viewport/color/keyboard/mouse/graphics capabilities, exact timed inputs, checkpoint timestamps, exit status, cleanup, artifact hashes, rerun count, and diff policy/result.

Exact settled gate: semantic cells and PNG pixels are identical outside enumerated `identity_text` and `truthful_dynamic_text` spans whose captured reference and candidate placements match their declared values. Each span must retain exact rectangles, styles, wrapping, canonical placeholder, and separate reference and candidate provenance. No geometry, component, cursor, focus, color, regex, row, component, region, or whole-surface mask is permitted.

Motion gate: rest/mid/settled checkpoints exist for every transition; scroll flush is 16 ms, gesture boundary 80 ms, active frame cadence 30 Hz, title frame hold 8 ticks, action-required blink 15 ticks, resize debounce 16 ms, and paste detection 2/10 ms unless the canonical source code exposes a different literal at the pinned revision. Candidate checkpoint order must match and timestamps stay within one relevant frame.

Smoothness gate: across five identical runs, candidate p95 input-to-frame and frame-interval distributions are no worse than 110% of reference, no gap exceeds 2x the expected cadence, scroll line conservation is exact, and idle redraw count is zero after settling.

Freshness gate: any edit to a renderer, state owner, theme, layout, font/capture configuration, or scenario invalidates all affected artifacts; final approval re-runs the complete matrix on one revision. Skip, timeout, premature exit, missing browser/font, missing checkpoint, forced cleanup without normal exit, dirty source, digest drift, or secret-scan finding is FAIL.

Runtime-reachability gate: every parity-owned module must be referenced by the installed product's live call graph or removed. `lib.rs` exports, module-local constructors, snapshots, unit tests, and dead-code-eliminated objects are not reachability evidence. The gate records the concrete `AppState -> input/event -> runtime -> ui::render_app -> module` chain and proves it with an installed-binary interaction.

Comparator-execution gate: the CLI must return nonzero for any cell, pixel, motion, timing, provenance, missing-checkpoint, abnormal-exit, or cleanup defect. Receipts must distinguish `capture_succeeded` from `comparison_passed`; absent comparator output is FAIL. Reviewers inspect the runner call graph before accepting matrix counts.

Binary gate: build Harness from the exact candidate SHA into a new isolated empty `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` after the final source edit. The receipt must postdate the source tree, name the full SHA, and bind every capture to that binary digest. A stale or pre-integration digest invalidates the full matrix.

Runner gate: after candidate freeze, build `tui-fidelity`, Harness, and Grok in separate empty isolated targets. Record the runner full source SHA, runner binary digest, Cargo.lock/toolchain hashes, and comparator-module hashes; every comparison row binds to all three executable digests. The runner may not read a revoked Task 2 candidate receipt.

Requirement-inventory gate: before recovery implementation, generate a separately reviewed requirement inventory from every Must-have, design journey, persona, terminal tier, module root, Todo 53-59 acceptance clause, and final-gate obligation in this exact plan. F1 and F4 freeze its hash against the reviewed plan SHA. `not_applicable`, omission, or scope reduction requires an explicit later user-approved plan change.

Coverage-manifest gate: generate expected matrix rows from the frozen requirement inventory, keyed by requirement ID, scenario, action path, viewport, terminal tier, input persona, theme/media mode, and failure path. Require an exact requirement-to-row mapping and a bijection between manifest entries and compared rows; absent requirements, absent rows, duplicate rows, or unexercised requirements fail. Each row has five timed trials for p95, and the complete manifest runs in three independent immutable evidence directories.

Independent-verdict gate: F1-F4 are produced by read-only reviewers that did not implement, orchestrate, or author the evidence being reviewed. Reviewer self-certification, an orchestrator-written `APPROVE`, a missing reviewer receipt, or a verdict that contradicts raw artifacts is FAIL.

Candidate-freeze gate: Todo 59 records the final implementation commit and freezes one full candidate SHA. Todos 49-52 and F1-F4 are verification-only and make no commits. Any product, test, scenario, runner, comparator, or capture-configuration repair discovered afterward returns to its owning Todo 53-58, creates a new commit, and forces Todo 59, Todos 49-52, and F1-F4 to rerun from the beginning.

Plan-integrity gate: Boulder and the revocation record store the SHA-256 of the exact high-accuracy-reviewed plan bytes. `closure-verify` hashes the live plan through a no-follow descriptor chain and rejects any mismatch, unchecked recovery/closure row, scope/applicability change, or stale review digest.

Boulder-transition gate: Boulder remains `active` until `tui-fidelity closure-complete` atomically verifies the SHA-bound closure receipt and performs the sole permitted `active -> completed` transition in both the selected `works` entry and mirror state. Direct `status=completed` edits in either location, works/mirror divergence, checkbox-only completion, missing receipt path/hash, receipt/candidate/plan mismatch, or replayed receipt must be rejected by the installed Boulder consumer and negative tests.

Session-provenance gate: every implementation, evidence-production, and reviewer dispatch records the harness-issued task/session receipt and parent/spawn edge in `task_sessions` before work begins. Review attestations bind role, session, plan SHA, candidate SHA, and evidence-manifest hash. `closure-verify` validates those receipts against authoritative coding-agent session/task provenance and rejects missing, forged, self-authored, role-overlapping, or string-only identities.

Required per-task command after Todo 4: `cargo run -p harness-testkit --bin tui-fidelity -- compare --scenario <scenario> --reference-bin <attemptDir>/reference-target/debug/xai-grok-pager --harness-bin <attemptDir>/harness-target/debug/harness --evidence-dir <taskEvidence>` plus the task's focused `cargo nextest` owner command.
Product-touching tasks also run `bash scripts/harness-qa-dogfood.sh --self-test`; final integration runs `scripts/test-lanes.sh fast`, `quality-gates`, `integration`, and `all-deterministic`.
